<thought>To determine the number of carbonyl (C=O) groups, the most direct and inexpensive method is to obtain the IR spectrum, which shows characteristic C=O stretching bands near 1700 cm⁻¹. By counting distinct strong carbonyl peaks in the IR data, we can infer the number of carbonyl groups present.</thought>
